name: hostilo
description: Publish, update and manage static websites on Hostilo from the chat: single-page and multi-file sites, 19 templates, ZIP import, versions with restore and visit stats.

interface.longDescription:
Hostilo puts the websites you build in ChatGPT online. Ask ChatGPT to make a landing page, a menu, a portfolio or a small game, then say "publish it on Hostilo". A minute later you get a live HTTPS address like yourname.hostilo.page that anyone can open.

What you can do from the chat:
- Publish a single-page site or a multi-file site (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, images).
- Start from one of 19 ready templates (cafe menu, local service, CV, wedding invitation, rental, nonprofit and more) and fill in your own name, phone and colors.
- Update a live site: ChatGPT reads the current code, changes it and publishes the new version.
- Import a ZIP file with a whole site.
- See your sites, their versions and restore an earlier version.
- Check visits on a site.

How it works: the first time, you sign in to Hostilo (or create an account) and approve access. ChatGPT only gets the permissions you see on the approval screen, and you can disconnect it at any time in your Hostilo account.

Hostilo hosts static websites only (no PHP or databases). Every site is scanned for phishing and malware.
defaultPrompt: Make a one-page website for my cafe and publish it on Hostilo.
Show my Hostilo websites and their visits this week.
Publish this HTML as a live website on Hostilo.

positive.prompt: Make a simple one-page website for a bike repair shop called "Spoke & Chain" in Berlin and publish it on Hostilo as spoke-review.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant writes the HTML, creates the site and replies with the live URL https://spoke-review.hostilo.page, which opens the page.

positive.description: Create a site from a template
positive.prompt: Show me Hostilo templates for a cafe, then create a cafe menu site called "Linden Cafe" with phone +48 600 100 200, as linden-review.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant lists templates, picks cafe-menu, creates the site with the given name and phone and returns its live URL.

positive.description: Edit a live site (happypaws-review is already in the test account)
positive.prompt: On my Hostilo site happypaws-review, change the main heading to "Dog walks every day" and make the buttons green.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant reads the current HTML, changes only the heading and button color and publishes. Reloading the URL shows the change.

positive.prompt: Which websites do I have on Hostilo and how many visits did they get this week?
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant lists the account's sites with their URLs and shows visit numbers for the last 7 days.

positive.description: Restore an earlier version of happypaws-review
positive.prompt: Show the versions of happypaws-review and go back to the version before my last change.
positive.expected_behavior: The assistant lists versions with dates and restores the previous one. The live page shows the old heading again.

negative.description: Not a website task, no Hostilo tool should be called
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Warsaw tomorrow?

negative.description: Server-side app with a database, which Hostilo does not host
negative.prompt: Publish my WordPress site with its MySQL database on Hostilo.

negative.description: Editing a site the user does not own
negative.prompt: Change the text on the Hostilo site google.hostilo.page.

publication.release_notes: First release: publish, update and manage static websites on Hostilo from ChatGPT. Single-page and multi-file sites, 19 templates, ZIP import, versions with restore, and visit stats.
